# Homa

> The calm homeschool assistant that shows you it's working.

URL: https://thankshoma.com

## What Homa Does

Homa is an AI homeschool assistant for parents of children ages 2 to 16. It learns each child, generates personalized printable materials, tracks hours for your state, and shows you it's working through progress reports mapped to your state's standards.

Homa is an AI homeschool assistant that tracks developmental progress for children ages 2 to 16 and generates personalized printable materials. Get a free progress report showing exactly where your child stands. Takes five minutes.

## Who It's For

Homeschool parents who want less admin and more teaching. Parents who use their own curriculum, co-ops, or a mix of bought, borrowed, and homemade materials. Families with children ages 2 to 16.

## Key Features

- Free developmental progress report (five-minute questionnaire, tuned to each child's age)
- Personalized printable worksheets and materials (richest for early years, growing from there)
- State standards mapping with subject coverage at a glance
- Hour tracking for state compliance
- AI assistant that plans around any curriculum: bought, borrowed, or homemade
- Reshuffles the week when things fall apart, nothing is lost
- Works for ages 2 to 16

## How It Works

1. Answer a five-minute questionnaire about your child
2. Get a free progress report showing exactly where they stand
3. Homa learns your child and generates personalized materials
4. Track hours, map to state standards, and see progress over time

## Try It

Get a free progress report: https://thankshoma.com/onboarding

## Important Details

- Homa is for parents only. Your child never sees the questionnaire and never talks to an AI.
- The progress report is free. Homa itself is free while the first families shape it. Pricing gets published before anyone pays a cent.
- Homa is a parent-facing tool, not a child-facing one.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Does Homa follow my state's standards?
A: Yes. Pick your state and every subject maps to it. You see coverage at a glance.

Q: Can I use my own curriculum?
A: Bring it. Homa plans around any mix of bought, borrowed, and homemade.

Q: What ages does it cover?
A: The progress report covers ages 2 to 16, with a questionnaire tuned to each age. Personalized materials are richest for the early years and growing from there.

Q: Does my child ever use it?
A: Never. Homa is for you: your child never sees the questionnaire and never talks to an AI.

Q: What if a week falls apart?
A: Tell Homa. She reshuffles, nothing is lost. A lighter week is still a school week.

Q: What does it cost?
A: The progress report is free. Homa itself is free while the first families shape it. Pricing gets published before anyone pays a cent.
